enums.name: CameraLensDirection
enums.doc: /// The direction the camera is facing.

values.name: front
values.doc: /// Front facing camera (a user looking at the screen is seen by the camera).

values.name: back
values.doc: /// Back facing camera (a user looking at the screen is not seen by the camera).

values.name: external
values.doc: /// External camera which may not be mounted to the device.

enums.name: CameraLensType

values.name: wide
values.doc: /// A built-in wide-angle camera device type.

values.name: telephoto
values.doc: /// A built-in camera device type with a longer focal length than a wide-angle camera.

values.name: ultraWide
values.doc: /// A built-in camera device type with a shorter focal length than a wide-angle camera.

values.name: unknown
values.doc: /// Unknown camera device type.

enums.name: ExposureMode
enums.doc: /// The possible exposure modes that can be set for a camera.

values.name: auto
values.doc: /// Automatically determine exposure settings.

values.name: locked
values.doc: /// Lock the currently determined exposure settings.

enums.name: FlashMode
enums.doc: /// The possible flash modes that can be set for a camera

values.name: off
values.doc: /// Do not use the flash when taking a picture.

values.name: auto
values.doc: /// Let the device decide whether to flash the camera when taking a picture.

values.name: always
values.doc: /// Always use the flash when taking a picture.

values.name: torch
values.doc: /// Turns on the flash light and keeps it on until switched off.

enums.name: FocusMode
enums.doc: /// The possible focus modes that can be set for a camera.

values.name: auto
values.doc: /// Automatically determine focus settings.

values.name: locked
values.doc: /// Lock the currently determined focus settings.

values.name: low
values.doc: /// 352x288 on iOS, ~240p on Android and Web

values.name: max
values.doc: /// The highest resolution available.

enums.name: VideoStabilizationMode
enums.doc: /// The possible video stabilization modes that can be capturing video.

values.name: off
values.doc: /// Video stabilization is disabled.

values.name: level1
values.doc: /// Least stabilized video stabilization mode with the least latency.

values.name: level2
values.doc: /// More stabilized video with more latency.

values.name: level3
values.doc: /// Most stabilized video with the most latency.
